mapper.select: select id, openid, nickname, avatar, stars, phone, password, school_id, school_verified, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from xl_travel_user where id = #{id}
select id, openid, nickname, avatar, stars, phone, password, school_id, school_verified, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from xl_travel_user where openid = #{openid}
select id, openid, nickname, avatar, stars, phone, password, school_id, school_verified, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from xl_travel_user where phone = #{phone}
mapper.insert: insert into xl_travel_user (openid, nickname, avatar, stars, phone, password, school_id, school_verified, create_time) values (#{openid}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{stars}, #{phone}, #{password}, #{schoolId}, #{schoolVerified}, now())
mapper.update: update xl_travel_user set stars = stars + #{addStars}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update xl_travel_user set password = #{password}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update xl_travel_user set phone = #{phone}, password = #{password}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and (phone is null or phone = '')
update xl_travel_user set school_id = #{schoolId}, school_verified = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
